note_power_up: "power-up" blocks hold a mushroom or a fire flower: the game picks at run time, a mushroom when Mario is small, a fire flower when he is big or fire. The ROM data does not say which.

notes.hidden_1up: A hidden 1-up block (only_if hidden_1up_flag) is drawn only while the game's Hidden1UpFlag is set: it is set at power-on and after a life is lost, and cleared once one such block has been drawn. A fresh game meets it in 1-1.
notes.hard_only: Entries with hard_only appear only in secondary hard mode: stages 5-3 and later.
notes.never_spawns: The enemy stream is read in order: an entry already left of the screen's right edge when it is reached is skipped (the game's PositionEnemyObj). Those entries are marked never_spawns.
notes.group: Enemy ids $37-$3E make 2-3 goombas / koopas 24 px apart at the screen's right edge when the entry is reached: x is approximate (approx_x), y is exact.
notes.from_pipe: Every pipe (decorative or not) spawns a piranha plant when its column is drawn, except in 1-1 (no_pipe_piranha). ram_y is the pipe top in screen y.
notes.frenzy: Entries that start a stream of cheep-cheeps / bullet bills / lakitu spinies are in `frenzy` (and `frenzies` for the area-object ones); the flying things they make are not listed.
notes.flag_get_x: Mario's x when the game reports flag_get: measured 7 px left of the flagpole x, 7 px right of the axe x.
notes.windows: Each stage area has a window [x0, x1): the part a visit can meet (the pipe-intro screen: none; a sub-area: from the entrance page; the shared bonus-room block: its one 512 px room). stage.summary is computed over the windows.

units.x: world pixels from the level's left edge (page * 256 + column * 16)
units.row: tile row 0-12 (row 11 is the first ground row); y = row * 16 in tile-buffer coordinates
units.ram_y: the byte the game holds in Enemy_Y_Position when the object spawns

source: SMB1 vanilla ROM (super-mario-bros.nes, as loaded by gym_super_mario_bros), decoded with the format of the community disassembly smbdis.asm

lost_levels.note: SuperMarioBros2 loads a different ROM (super-mario-bros-2.nes, The Lost Levels); not decoded here
